# Java Edition protocol/Registries

> Minecraft Java snapshot: `1.21.8`  
> Protocol version: `772`  
> Source: [Java Edition protocol/Registries](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Registries?oldid=3018939)

Registries are repositories of data that contain entries pertaining to certain aspects of the game, such as the world, the player, among others.

The ability for the server to send customized registries to the client was introduced in 1.16.3, which allows for a great deal of customization over certain features of the game.

## Overview

The server sends these registries to the client via [Registry Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Registry_Data "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") packet during the configuration phase.

| Packet ID | State | Bound To | Field Name | | Field Type | | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Varies](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Registry_Data_2 "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") | Configuration | Client | Registry ID | | [Identifier](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Identifier "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | |  |
| Entries | Entry ID | [Prefixed Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | [Identifier](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Identifier "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| Data | [Prefixed Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Prefixed_Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [NBT](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:NBT "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Entry data. |

The structure of the entries' data depends on the registry specified in the packet. The structure for each [available registry](https://minecraft.wiki#Available_Registries) is defined below.

Throughout the configuration phase, the server will send multiple [Registry Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Registry_Data "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") packets, each one pertaining to a different registry.

### Client/Server Exchange

In order to save bandwidth, the server omits the data for entries pertaining to a data pack that is mutually supported by both the client and server. The exchange is as follows:

1. **S**→**C**: [Clientbound Known Packs](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Clientbound_Known_Packs "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol")
2. **C**→**S**: [Serverbound Known Packs](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Serverbound_Known_Packs "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol")
3. *Server computes the mutually supported data packs*
4. **S**→**C**: Multiple [Registry Data](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Registry_Data "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") (excluding mutually supported data)

[![](https://minecraft.wiki/images/thumb/Ambox_warning_pn.png/32px-Ambox_warning_pn.png?b6e1c)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Ambox_warning_pn.png "File:Ambox warning pn.png")

The ordering in which the entries of a registry are sent defines the numeric ID that they will be assigned to. It is essential to maintain consistency between server and client, since many parts of the protocol reference these entries by their ID. The client will disconnect upon receiving a reference to a non-existing entry.

## Available Registries

The current release specification allows for nine different registries to be sent to the client. A brief explanation of each of them is presented below, along with the format of their entries' element field.

**Fields marked in \_\_ blue represent data for server-side exclusive operations, and thus have no visible impact on the client.**

### Armor Trim Material

The `minecraft:trim_material` registry. It defines various visual properties of trim materials in armors.

| Name | | | Type | | Meaning | | Values | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asset\_name | | | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The trim color model to be rendered on top of the armor. The Notchian client uses the corresponding asset located at `trims/color_palettes`. | | Example: "minecraft:amethyst". | |
| ingredient | | | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The ingredient used. This has the visual effect of showing the trimmed armor model on the Smithing Table when the correct item is placed. | | Example: "minecraft:copper\_ingot". | |
| item\_model\_index | | | [Float Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:float_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | Color index of the trim on the armor item when in the inventory. | | Default values vary between 0.1 and 1.0. | |
| override\_armor\_materials | | | Optional [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | Asset for different types of armor materials, which overrides the value specified in the asset\_name field. The Notchian client uses this to give a darker color shade when a trim material is applied to armor of the same material, such as iron applied to iron armor. | | The key can be either:  - `leather` - `chainmail` - `iron` - `gold` - `diamond` - `turtle` - `netherite`   The value accepts the same values as asset\_name. | |
| description | | | [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") or [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The name of the trim material to be displayed on the armor tool-tip. Any styling used in this component is also applied to the trim pattern description. | | See [Text formatting](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Text_formatting "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Text formatting"). | |

### Biome

The `minecraft:worldgen/biome` registry. It defines several aesthetic characteristics of the biomes present in the game.

Biome entries are referenced in the [Chunk Biomes](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Chunk_Biomes "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") and [Chunk Data and Update Light](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Chunk_Data_and_Update_Light "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") packets.

| Name | | | Type | | Meaning | | Values | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| has\_precipitation | | | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | Determines whether or not the biome has precipitation. | | 1: true, 0: false. | |
| temperature | | | [Float Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:float_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The temperature factor of the biome. Affects foliage and grass color if they are not explicitly set. | | The default values vary between -0.5 and 2.0. | |
| temperature\_modifier | | | Optional [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | Modifier that affects the resulting temperature. | | Can be either:  - `none`, for a static temperature throughout the biome (aside from variations depending on the height). - `frozen`, for pockets of warm temperature (0.2) to be randomly distributed throughout the biome. This is used on frozen ocean variants in the Notchian client to simulate spots of unfrozen water, where it always rains instead of snowing. | |
| downfall | | | [Float Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:float_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The downfall factor of the biome. Affects foliage and grass color if they are not explicitly set. | | The default values vary between 0.0 and 1.0. | |
| effects | | | [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | Biome special effects. | | See [Effects](https://minecraft.wiki#Effects). | |

### Chat Type

The `minecraft:chat_type` registry. It defines the different types of in-game chat and how they're formatted.

Chat type entries are referenced in the [Disguised Chat Message](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Disguised_Chat_Message "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") and [Player Chat Message](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Player_Chat_Message "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") packets.

| Name | | | Type | | Meaning | | Values | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| chat | | | [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The chat decoration. | | See [Decoration](https://minecraft.wiki#Decoration). | |
| narration | | | [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The narration decoration. | | See [Decoration](https://minecraft.wiki#Decoration). | |

#### Decoration

| Name | | | Type | | Meaning | | Values | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| translation\_key | | | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | The translation key representing the chat format. It can also be a formatting string directly. | | Example: "chat.type.text", which translates to "<%s> %s". | |
| style | | | Optional [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | Optional styling to be applied on the final message. Not present in the narration decoration. | | See [Text formatting#Styling fields](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Text_formatting#Styling_fields "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Text formatting"). | |
| parameters | | | [List Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:list_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") of [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | | Placeholders used when formatting the string given by the translation\_key field. | | Can be either:  - `sender`, for the name of the player sending the message. - `target`, for the name of the player receiving the message, which may be empty. - `content`, for the actual message. | |

### Damage Type

The `minecraft:damage_type` registry. It defines the different types of damage an entity can sustain.

Damage type entries are referenced in the [Damage Event](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Damage_Event "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") packet.

| Name | Type | Meaning | Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| message\_id | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Id of the death message. The full message is displayed as `death.attack.<message_id>`. | Example: "onFire". |
| scaling | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether the damage taken scales with the difficulty. | Can be either:  - `never` - `when_caused_by_living_non_player` - `always` |
| exhaustion | [Float Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:float_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The amount of exhaustion caused when suffering this type of damage. | Default values are either 0.0 or 0.1. |
| effects | Optional [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Effect played when the player suffers this damage, including the sound that is played. | Can be either:  - `hurt` - `thorns` - `drowning` - `burning` - `poking` - `freezing` |
| death\_message\_type | Optional [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Defines how the death message is constructed. | Can be either:  - `default`, for the message to be built normally. - `fall_variants`, for the most significant fall damage to be considered. - `intentional_game_design`, for [MCPE-28723](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MCPE-28723) to be considered as an argument when translating the message. |

### Dimension Type

The `minecraft:dimension_type` registry. It defines the types of dimension that can be attributed to a world, along with all their characteristics.

Dimension type entries are referenced in the [Login (play)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Login_(play) "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") and [Respawn](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Respawn "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol") packets.

| Name | Type | Meaning | Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fixed\_time | Optional [Long Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:long_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | If set, the time of the day fixed to the specified value. | Allowed values vary between 0 and 24000. |
| has\_skylight | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether the dimension has skylight access or not. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| has\_ceiling | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether the dimension has a bedrock ceiling or not. When true, causes lava to spread faster. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| ultrawarm | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether the dimensions behaves like the nether (water evaporates and sponges dry) or not. Also causes lava to spread thinner. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| natural | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | When false, compasses spin randomly. When true, nether portals can spawn zombified piglins. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| coordinate\_scale | [Double Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:double_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The multiplier applied to coordinates when traveling to the dimension. | Allowed values vary between 1e-5 (0.00001) and 3e7 (30000000). |
| bed\_works | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether players can use a bed to sleep. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| respawn\_anchor\_works | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether players can charge and use respawn anchors. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| min\_y | [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The minimum Y level. | Allowed values vary between -2032 and 2031, and must also be a multiple of 16. min\_y + height cannot exceed 2032. |
| height | [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The maximum height. | Allowed values vary between 16 and 4064, and must also be a multiple of 16. min\_y + height cannot exceed 2032. |
| logical\_height | [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The maximum height to which chorus fruits and nether portals can bring players within this dimension. (Must be lower than height) | Allowed values vary between 0 and 4064, and must also be a multiple of 16. logical\_height cannot exceed the height. |
| infiniburn | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | A resource location defining what block tag to use for infiniburn. | "#" or minecraft resource "#minecraft:...". |
| effects | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Defines special dimensional effects, which includes:  - Cloud level: Height at which clouds appear, if at all. - Sky type: Whether it's the normal sky with sun and moon; the low-visibility, foggy sky of the nether; or the static sky of the end. - Forced light map: Whether a bright light map is forced, siimilar to the night vision effect. - Constant ambient light: Whether blocks have shade on their faces. | Can be either:  - `minecraft:overworld`, for clouds at 192, normal sky type, normal light map and normal ambient light. - `minecraft:the_nether`, for **no clouds**, nether sky type, normal light map and **constant** ambient light. - `minecraft:the_end`, for **no clouds**, end sky type, **forced** light map and normal ambient light. |
| ambient\_light | [Float Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:float_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | How much light the dimension has. Used as interpolation factor when calculating the brightness generated from sky light. | The default values are 0.0 and 0.1, 0.1 for the nether and 0.0 for the other dimensions. |
| piglin\_safe | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether piglins shake and transform to zombified piglins. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| has\_raids | [Byte Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:byte_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Whether players with the Bad Omen effect can cause a raid. | 1: true, 0: false. |
| monster\_spawn\_light\_level | [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") or [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | During a monster spawn attempt, this is the maximum allowed light level for it to succeed. It can be either a fixed value, or one of several types of distributions. | Can be either:  - as a [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT"): Allowed values vary between 0 and 15. - as a [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT"): See [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Dimension_type). |
| monster\_spawn\_block\_light\_limit | [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Maximum allowed block light level monster spawn attempts to happen. | Allowed values vary between 0 and 15. The default values are 0 and 15, 15 for the nether (where monsters can spawn anywhere) and 0 for other dimensions (where monsters can only spawn naturally in complete darkness). |

### Wolf Variant

The `minecraft:wolf_variant` registry. It defines the textures for different wolf variants.

| Name | Type | Meaning | Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| wild\_texture | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The texture for the wild version of this wolf. The Notchian client uses the corresponding asset located at `textures`. | Example: "minecraft:entity/wolf/wolf\_ashen". |
| tame\_texture | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The texture for the tamed version of this wolf. The Notchian client uses the corresponding asset located at `textures`. | Example: "minecraft:entity/wolf/wolf\_ashen\_tame". |
| angry\_texture | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The texture for the angry version of this wolf. The Notchian client uses the corresponding asset located at `textures`. | Example: "minecraft:entity/wolf/wolf\_ashen\_angry". |
| biomes | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") or [List Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:list_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | Biomes in which this wolf can spawn in. | See [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Wolf#Wolf_variants). |

### Painting Variant

The `minecraft:painting_variant` registry. It defines the textures and dimensions for the game's paintings.

| Name | Type | Meaning | Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asset\_id | [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The texture for the painting. The Notchian client uses the corresponding asset located at `textures/painting`. | Example: "minecraft:backyard". |
| height | [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The height of the painting, in blocks. | Example: `2` |
| width | [Int Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:int_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The width of the painting, in blocks. |  |
| title | [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") or [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The displayed title of the painting. See [Text formatting](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Text_formatting "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Text formatting"). | Example: `{"color": "gray", "translate": "painting.minecraft.skeleton.title"}` |
| author | [Compound Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:compound_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") or [String Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/NBT#Specification:string_tag "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/NBT") | The displayed author of the painting. See [Text formatting](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Text_formatting "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Text formatting"). | Example: `{"color": "gray", "translate": "painting.minecraft.skeleton.author"}` |
